title: Irish Toasted Keto Bread
description: A keto version of traditional Irish toast, made with bread and perfect as a breakfast option.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add butter to the skillet and melt.
Place the lightly toasted Irish bread in the skillet.
Crack 2 large eggs into a bowl and scramble them.
Add the scrambled eggs to the bread in the skillet.
Add 2 slices of crumbled bacon to the eggs.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup of chopped cheddar cheese over the top.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
